title: A Deep Learning Framework for Accelerated Electron Ptychography with Balanced Accuracy and Efficiency
content: Electron ptychography has emerged as a powerful computational imaging technique for achieving high-resolution phase-contrast reconstructions in electron microscopy, enabling unprecedented insights into nanoscale material structures [1-3]. However, traditional iterative reconstruction methods suffer from high computational complexity, particularly for large-scale datasets [4-6], while existing deep-learning based methods often suffer from generalization problems for thick specimens, as they struggle with the excessively high dimensionality and large volume of such data. To address these challenges, this work introduces a novel deep learning framework that synergistically balances reconstruction accuracy, computational efficiency, and user-friendliness.
